questions.enonce: ........ can old phones be recycled ? — In specialised recycling facilities.
questions.explication: La réponse est un lieu : Where.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ do people repair their devices ? — Because it is cheaper and better for the environment.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ was the first major e-waste law introduced in Japan ? — In 2001.
questions.explication: Une date est un moment précis : When.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ does planned obsolescence encourage people to do ? — To replace products quickly.
questions.explication: La réponse est une action, une chose : What.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ organization publishes the Global E-waste Monitor ?
questions.explication: Which + nom : choix dans un ensemble précis (ici les organisations).
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ has become a leader in repairable smartphones ? — Fairphone has.
questions.explication: Une entreprise ou une personne sujet : Who (ou Which company).
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ countries have adopted laws on e-waste ? — More than 80.
questions.explication: Des pays se comptent : How many.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ e-waste is produced worldwide each year ?
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ do consumers replace their smartphones ? — Every two or three years.
questions.explication: « Every two or three years » est une fréquence : How often.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

questions.enonce: ........ has the campaign been running ? — For three years.
questions.explication: « For three years » est une durée : How long.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

choix: Which organization does publish the report ?
Does which organization publish the report ?
questions.explication: Quand le mot interrogatif est le sujet, pas de do/does et le verbe garde son -s.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)

choix: How often consumers replace their phones ?
How often do consumers replace their phones ?
How often do consumers replaces their phones ?
How often replace consumers their phones ?
questions.explication: Mot interrogatif + do + sujet + base verbale.
questions.source: Mock exam L2 MIM/PCI CC1, partie 2 (mots interrogatifs)
